paragraphs: Unless otherwise expressly indicated or the context otherwise requires, in this Annual Report on Form 10-K:

•We use the terms "Malibu Boats," the "Company," "MBI," "we," "us," "our" or similar references to refer (1) prior to the consummation of our initial public offering, or "IPO" on February 5, 2014, to Malibu Boats Holdings, LLC (the "LLC"), and its consolidated subsidiaries and (2) after our IPO, to Malibu Boats, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries;
•We use the term "Boats LLC" to refer to the LLC's subsidiary Malibu Boats, LLC;
•We refer to the owners of membership interests in the LLC immediately prior to the consummation of the IPO, collectively, as our "pre-IPO owners";
•We refer to owners of membership interests in the LLC (the "LLC Units"), collectively, as our "LLC members";
•References to "fiscal year" refer to the fiscal year of Malibu Boats, which ends on June 30 of each year;

•We refer to our Malibu branded boats as "Malibu", our Axis Wake Research branded boats as "Axis", our Pursuit branded boats as "Pursuit", our Maverick, Cobia, Pathfinder and Hewes branded boats as "Maverick Boat Group", our Cobalt branded boats as "Cobalt", and our Saxdor branded boats as "Saxdor";
•We use the term "recreational powerboat industry" to refer to our industry group, which includes performance sport boats, sterndrive boats, outboard boats, and premium adventure dayboats;

•We use the term "performance sport boat category" to refer to the industry category, consisting primarily of fiberglass boats equipped with inboard propulsion and ranging from 19 feet to 26 feet in length, which we believe most closely corresponds to (1) the inboard ski/wakeboard category, as defined and tracked by the National Marine Manufacturers Association (the "NMMA"), and (2) the inboard ski boat category, as defined and tracked by Statistical Surveys, Inc., or SSI;

•We use the terms "sterndrive" and "outboard" to refer to the industry category, consisting primarily of sterndrive and outboard boats ranging from 20 feet to 40 feet, which most closely corresponds to the sterndrive and outboard categories, as defined and tracked by NMMA, and the sterndrive and outboard propulsion categories, as defined and tracked by SSI; in some instances, we provide market information based on specific boat lengths or boat types within the sterndrive or outboard categories to reflect our performance in those specific markets in which we offer products; we include "premium adventure dayboats" in the industry categories of "sterndrive" and "outboard", depending on the propulsion system used; and

•References to certain market and industry data presented in this Form 10-K are determined as follows: (1) U.S. boat sales and unit volume for the overall powerboat industry and any powerboat category during any calendar year are based on retail boat market data from the NMMA and (2) U.S. market share and unit volume for the overall powerboat industry and any powerboat category during any fiscal year ended June 30 or any calendar year ended December 31 are based on comparable same-state retail boat registration data from SSI, for which data was available for all 50 states as of the date of this Form 10-K.

This Annual Report on Form 10-K includes our trademarks, such as "Monsoon," "Surf Gate," "Wakesetter," "Surf Band," and "Swim Step," which are protected under applicable intellectual property laws and are the property of Malibu Boats, Inc. This Form 10-K also contains trademarks, service marks, trade names and copyrights of other companies, which are the property of their respective owners. Solely for convenience, trademarks and trade names referred to in this Form 10-K may appear without the ® or TM symbols, but such references are not intended to indicate, in any way, that we will not assert, to the fullest extent under applicable law, our rights or the right of the applicable licensor to these trademarks and trade names.

We are a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of a diverse range of recreational powerboats, including performance sport boats, sterndrive boats, outboard boats, and premium adventure dayboats under nine brands—Malibu, Axis, Pursuit, Maverick, Cobia, Pathfinder, Hewes, Cobalt, and Saxdor. As of June 30, 2026, we are among the market leaders in the United States in the performance sport boat category through our Malibu and Axis brands, we are among the market leaders in the United States in the 20'- 40' segment of the sterndrive category through our Cobalt brand, and we are among the market leaders in the fiberglass outboard fishing boat market with our Pursuit and Maverick Boat Group brands. For our Saxdor brand,

we have multiple award-winning models making Saxdor a recognized brand in the premium adventure dayboat emerging market. Our product portfolio of premium brands is used for a broad range of recreational boating activities including, among others, water sports such as water skiing, wakeboarding and wake surfing, as well as general recreational boating and fishing. Our passion for consistent innovation, which has led to proprietary technology such as Surf Gate, has allowed us to expand the market for our products by introducing consumers to new and exciting recreational activities. We design products that appeal to an expanding range of recreational boaters and water sports enthusiasts whose passion for boating and water sports is a key aspect of their lifestyle and provide consumers with a better customer-inspired experience. With performance, quality, value and multi-purpose features, our product portfolio has us well positioned to broaden our addressable market and achieve our goal of increasing our market share in the recreational boating industry.

headings: Risks Related to our Business and Operations
Risks Related to Our Markets and the Recreational Powerboat Industry
paragraphs: The following describes the risks and uncertainties that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those presented in our forward-looking statements. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face but do represent those risks and uncertainties that we believe are material to us. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also harm our business.
We have a large fixed-cost base that will affect our profitability when demand decreases or when our costs increase at a faster rate than our revenue.

The fixed cost levels of operating a recreational powerboat manufacturer can put pressure on profit margins when sales and production decline or when costs rise. Our profitability depends, in part, on our ability to spread fixed costs over a sufficiently large number of products sold and shipped. If we reduce our rate of production or otherwise experience lower revenues or if our costs increase at a faster rate than our sales, gross margins will be negatively affected. For instance, in fiscal year 2026 our net sales increased at a smaller percentage than our expenses increased and, as a result, our gross margin and net income decreased.
We may not be able to execute our manufacturing strategy successfully, which could cause the profitability of our products to suffer.

Our manufacturing strategy is designed to produce high quality products, while reducing costs and increasing flexibility to respond to ongoing changes in the marketplace. To implement this strategy, we must be successful in our continuous improvement efforts, which depend on the involvement of management, production employees and suppliers. Any inability to achieve our objectives under our manufacturing strategy could adversely impact the profitability of our products and our ability to deliver desirable products to our consumers.

In addition, we have made strategic capital investments in capacity expansion activities to successfully capture growth opportunities and enhance product offerings, including plant expansions. For example, we purchased a production facility in Roane County, Tennessee and moved production of certain models of our Cobalt boats from Kansas to Tennessee. Moving production to a different plant and expanding capacity at an existing facility involves risks, including difficulties initiating production within the cost and timeframe estimated, supplying product to customers when expected, integrating new products, and attracting sufficient skilled labor to handle additional production demands. If we fail to meet these objectives, it could adversely affect our ability to meet customer demand for products and increase the cost of production versus projections, both of which could result in a significant adverse impact on our operating and financial results. Additionally, plant expansion can result in manufacturing inefficiencies, additional expenses, including higher wages or severance costs, and cost inefficiencies, which could negatively impact financial results.

We are a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of a diverse range of recreational powerboats, including performance sport boats, sterndrive, outboard boats, and premium adventure dayboats. Our product portfolio of premium brands is used for a broad range of recreational boating activities including, among others, water sports, such as water skiing, wakeboarding and wake surfing, as well as general recreational boating and fishing. Our passion for consistent innovation, which has led to proprietary technology such as Surf Gate, has allowed us to expand the market for our products by introducing consumers to new and exciting recreational activities. We design products that appeal to an expanding range of recreational boaters and water sports enthusiasts whose passion for boating and water sports is a key aspect of their lifestyle and provide consumers with a better customer-inspired experience. With performance, quality, value and multi-purpose features, our product portfolio has us well positioned to broaden our addressable market and achieve our goal of increasing our market share in the recreational boating industry.

In March 2026, we acquired Saxdor Yachts Oy ("Saxdor"). Saxdor is a leading European designer and manufacturer of premium adventure dayboats. Saxdor has a team of approximately 800 employees with three engineering and manufacturing facilities in Finland and Poland. See "Acquisition of Saxdor" below for more information.

We currently sell our boats under nine brands as shown in the table below, and we report our results of operations under four reportable segments, Malibu, Saltwater Fishing, Cobalt, and Saxdor. Our Malibu segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale throughout the world of Malibu and Axis performance sports boats. Our flagship Malibu boats offer our latest innovations in performance, comfort and convenience, and are designed for consumers seeking a premium performance sport boat experience. As of June 30, 2026, we

are among the market leaders in the United States in the performance sport boat category through our Malibu and Axis brands. Our Axis boats appeal to consumers who desire a more affordable performance sport boat product but still demand high performance, functional simplicity and the option to upgrade key features. Retail prices of our Malibu and Axis boats typically range from $80,000 to $300,000.

Our Saltwater Fishing segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale throughout the world of Pursuit boats and the Maverick Boat Group family of boats (Maverick, Cobia, Pathfinder and Hewes). Our Pursuit boats include center console, dual console and offshore models. Our Maverick Boat Group family of boats are highly complementary to Pursuit, expanding our saltwater outboard offerings with a strong focus in length segments under 30 feet. We are among the market leaders in the fiberglass outboard fishing boat category with the brands in our Saltwater Fishing segment. Retail prices for our Saltwater Fishing boats typically range from $45,000 to $1,400,000.

Our Cobalt segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale throughout the world of Cobalt boats. Our Cobalt boats consist of mid to large-sized luxury cruisers and bowriders that we believe offer the ultimate experience in comfort, performance and quality. As of June 30, 2026, we are among the market leaders in the United States in the 20' - 40' segment of the sterndrive boat category through our Cobalt brand. Retail prices for our Cobalt boats typically range from $75,000 to $625,000.

Our Saxdor segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale throughout the world of Saxdor boats. Our Saxdor boats expand our product offerings into the premium adventure dayboat market, including boats with lengths over 40 feet. Through our acquisition of Saxdor on March 2, 2026, we have expanded our international footprint to 68 countries. Retail prices for our Saxdor boats typically range from $130,000 to $825,000.

We sell our boats through a dealer network that we believe is among the strongest in the recreational powerboat industry. As of June 30, 2026, our distribution channel consisted of over 345 dealer locations globally. Our dealer base is an important part of our consumers' experience, our marketing efforts and our brands. We devote significant time and resources to find, develop and improve the performance of our dealers and believe our dealer network gives us a distinct competitive advantage. We had one dealer that represented more than 10% of our consolidated net sales in fiscal years 2026 and 2025.

• 我們將持有LLC之會員權益之所有者（"LLC Units"）， collectively，稱為我們的 "LLC members"；
• 有關 "財務年度" 之提及，係指Malibu Boats之財務年度，每年於6月30日結訖；

• 我們將我們的Malibu品牌船隻稱為 "Malibu"，我們的Axis Wake Research品牌船隻稱為 "Axis"，我們的Pursuit品牌船隻稱為 "Pursuit"，我們的Maverick、Cobia、Pathfinder及Hewes品牌船隻稱為 "Maverick Boat Group"，我們的Cobalt品牌船隻稱為 "Cobalt"，以及我們的Saxdor品牌船隻稱為 "Saxdor"；

•我們使用 "performance sport boat category" 這個詞語來指稱產業類別，主要由以玻璃纖維製成、裝備內燃機推進系統、長度介於 19 英尺至 26 英尺之間的船隻組成，我們認為這個類別最接近 (1) 美國船艇製造協會 (the "NMMA") 所定義並追蹤的 "inboard ski/wakeboard" 類別，以及 (2) 美國統計調查公司 (Statistical Surveys, Inc., 或 SSI) 所定義並追蹤的 "inboard ski boat" 類別；

•我們使用 "sterndrive" 和 "outboard" 這兩個詞語來指稱產業類別，主要由 sterndrive 和 outboard 船隻組成，長度介於 20 英尺至 40 英尺之間，這個類別最接近 NMMA 所定義並追蹤的 sterndrive 和 outboard 類別，以及 SSI 所定義並追蹤的 sterndrive 和 outboard 推進系統類別；在某些情況下，我們會根據 sterndrive 或 outboard 類別中特定船隻長度或船型提供市場資訊，以反映我們在這些特定市場的表現；我們根據所使用的推進系統，將 "premium adventure dayboats" 包含在 "sterndrive" 和 "outboard" 產業類別中；

•本 Form 10-K 所呈現的某些市場與產業數據的參考依據如下：(1) 任何曆年內整體動力船艇產業與任何動力船艇類別的美國船艇銷售額與單元數量，均根據 NMMA 提供的零售船艇市場數據；(2) 任何財務年度結算日為 6 月 30 日或任何曆年結算日為 12 月 31 日的美國市場佔有率與單元數量，均根據 SSI 提供的可比相同州零售船艇登記數據，且截至本 Form 10-K 提交日，數據已涵蓋所有 50 個州；

本年度 Form 10-K 報告包含我們的商標，例如 "Monsoon"、"Surf Gate"、"Wakesetter"、"Surf Band" 和 "Swim Step"，這些商標受適用的智慧財產權法規保護，為 Malibu Boats, Inc. 所擁有。本 Form 10-K 也包含其他公司的商標、服務標誌、商號與著作權，這些為其各自所有者所有。僅為方便起見，本 Form 10-K 所提及的商標與商號可能未標註 ® 或 TM 記號，但此等參考並非意圖表示，我們不會根據適用法律，全力主張我們對這些商標與商號之權利或適用授權人的權利；

我們是設計、製造與行銷多樣化休閒動力船艇的領導品牌，包括性能運動船艇、sterndrive 船艇、outboard 船艇與 premium adventure dayboats，旗下擁有九個品牌—Malibu、Axis、Pursuit、Maverick、Cobia、Pathfinder、Hewes、Cobalt 和 Saxdor。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我們透過 Malibu 和 Axis 品牌，在美國性能運動船艇類別中為市場領導者之一；我們透過 Cobalt 品牌，在美國 20' 至 40' 的 sterndrive 類別中為市場領導者之一；我們透過 Pursuit 和 Maverick Boat Group 品牌，在玻璃纖維 outboard 魚船市場中為市場領導者之一。針對我們的 Saxdor 品牌，

我們擁有多款獲獎肯定的船型，使 Saxdor 成為 premium adventure dayboat 新興市場中備受認可的品牌。我們的 premium 品牌產品組合用於廣泛的休閒船艇活動，包括但不限於水上運動如水 skiing、wakeboarding 和 wake surfing，以及一般休閒船艇與釣魚活動。我們對持續創新熱忱的追求，已導致專利技術如 Surf Gate 的產生，使我們能透過引入消費者至新興且令人興奮的休閒活動，來擴大我們產品的市場。我們設計的產品吸引更廣泛的休閒船艇愛好者與水上運動熱衷者，他們對船艇與水上運動的熱情是其生活方式的重要組成部分，並為消費者提供更貼近客戶需求的體驗。憑藉性能、品質、價值與多功能特點，我們的產品組合使我們在拓展可接觸市場與實現於休閒船艇產業中提高市場佔有率的目標上處於優勢位置。

本公司為領先的遊艇設計、製造與行銷廠商，產品包含多樣化的娛樂用動力船隻，包括性能運動船、舵機船、外燃機船及高階冒險日用船。本公司高階品牌的產品組合用於廣泛的娛樂船隻活動，包括水上運動，如水上摩托、衝浪板與浪板，以及一般娛樂船隻與釣魚活動。本公司對持續創新熱忱，已發展出專利技術如Surf Gate，使我們能透過引進新興且令人興奮的娛樂活動，拓展產品市場。本公司設計的產品吸引日益擴大的娛樂船隻與水上運動愛好者，他們對船隻與水上運動的熱情是其生活的重要部分，並為消費者提供更貼近需求的使用體驗。以性能、品質、價值與多用途特點為核心，本公司產品組合使我們處於有利位置，可拓展可接觸市場，並達成提高娛樂船隻產業市場佔有率的目標。
2026年3月，本公司取得Saxdor Yachts Oy（"Saxdor"）的公司。Saxdor為歐洲領先的高階冒險日用船設計與製造廠商。Saxdor約有800名員工，於芬蘭與波蘭設有三個工程與製造廠房。有關取得Saxdor的詳細資訊，請參閱下方"取得Saxdor"部分。
本公司目前以九個品牌銷售船隻，如下方表格所示，並以四個應報告分部報告營運結果，即Malibu、Saltwater Fishing、Cobalt與Saxdor。因取得Saxdor，本公司於2026年3月31日結業季度，重新調整分部報告，以以下四個應報告分部報告營運結果。

我們的 Malibu 分部參與 Malibu 與 Axis 高性能運動船艇的製造、運輸、行銷與全球銷售。我們的旗艦 Malibu 船艇提供我們最新的性能、舒適與便利創新，並為追求 premium 高性能運動船艇體驗的消費者所設計。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我們
在美國高性能運動船艇類別中，透過 Malibu 與 Axis 品牌，我們是市場領導者之一。我們的 Axis 船艇吸引那些希望擁有更具成本效益的高性能運動船艇產品，但仍要求高性能、功能簡潔與可升級關鍵特性的消費者。我們的 Malibu 與 Axis 船艇零售價格通常介於 80,000 美元至 300,000 美元之間。

我們的 Saltwater Fishing 分部參與 Pursuit 船艇與 Maverick Boat Group 家族船艇（Maverick、Cobia、Pathfinder 與 Hewes）的製造、運輸、行銷與全球銷售。我們的 Pursuit 船艇包括中控臺、雙控臺與遠洋型號。我們的 Maverick Boat Group 家族船艇與 Pursuit 高度補充，擴展我們的鹽水外機船艇產品線，並強調在 30 英尺以下長度段的強勢表現。我們在纖維玻璃外機釣魚船艇類別中，透過 Saltwater Fishing 分部的品牌，是市場領導者之一。我們的 Saltwater Fishing 船艇零售價格通常介於 45,000 美元至 1,400,000 美元之間。

我們的 Cobalt 分部參與 Cobalt 船艇的製造、運輸、行銷與全球銷售。我們的 Cobalt 船艇包括中至大型的豪華遊艇與船首跳板船，我們認為這些船艇提供極致的舒適、性能與品質體驗。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我們透過 Cobalt 品牌，在美國 20' 至 40' 的外機船艇類別中，是市場領導者之一。我們的 Cobalt 船艇零售價格通常介於 75,000 美元至 625,000 美元之間。
我們的 Saxdor 分部參與 Saxdor 船艇的製造、運輸、行銷與全球銷售。我們的 Saxdor 船艇擴展我們的產品線至 premium 冒險日用船市場，包括長度超過 40 英尺的船艇。透過我們於 2026 年 3 月 2 日收購 Saxdor，我們已將國際足跡擴展至 68 個國家。我們的 Saxdor 船艇零售價格通常介於 130,000 美元至 825,000 美元之間。

我們透過我們認為在休閒動力船艇產業中屬於最強的經銷網路銷售我們的船艇。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，我們的銷售通路包含全球超過 345 個經銷點。我們的經銷體系是我們消費者體驗、行銷努力與品牌的重點部分。我們投入大量時間與資源尋找、發展與提升我們經銷商的表現，並認為我們的經銷網路給予我們顯著的競爭優勢。我們在財務年度 2026 與 2025 期間，有一家經銷商代表我們合併後淨銷售額超過 10%。

paragraphs: 下列內容說明了可能導致我們實際結果與我們向前看陳述中所呈現結果有重大差異的風險與不確定性。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險，但這些風險與不確定性是我們認為對我們而言屬重要的。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們擁有龐大的固定成本基礎，當需求下降或我們的成本增加速度高於收入時，將會影響我們的獲利能力。
經營休閒用動力船製造商的固定成本水平，當銷售與生產下降或成本上升時，可能會對利潤率造成壓力。我們的獲利能力部分取決於我們能否將固定成本分攤至足夠多的產品銷售與出貨數量。若我們降低生產速度或否則遭遇較低收入，或我們的成本增加速度高於銷售額，毛利率將會受到負面影響。例如，在財務年度2026年，我們的淨銷售額增加比例小於成本增加比例，因此我們的毛利率與淨收入均下降。
我們可能無法成功執行我們的製造策略，這可能會導致我們產品的獲利能力受損。
我們的製造策略旨在生產高品質產品，同時降低成本並增加靈活性以應對市場的持續變化。為實現此策略，我們必須成功進行持續改進工作，這取決於管理階層、生產員工與供應商的參與。若我們無法在製造策略下達成目標，將會對我們產品的獲利能力及我們向消費者提供理想產品的能力造成不利影響。

此外，我們已針對擴充產能活動進行戰略性資本投資，以成功把握成長機會並提升產品組合，包括廠區擴建。例如，我們購買新的生產廠區位於田納西州Roane縣，並將部分Cobalt船型的生產從堪薩斯州遷移至田納西州。將生產遷移至不同廠區並在現有廠區擴充產能涉及風險，包括在預估成本與時間內啟動生產的困難、按預期時間向客戶供應產品的困難、整合新產品，以及吸引足夠具專業技能的勞工以應對增加的生產需求。若我們未能達成這些目標，可能會對我們滿足客戶產品需求的能力造成不利影響，並增加生產成本與預測值相比的差距，這兩者均可能對我們的營運與財務結果造成重大負面影響。此外，廠區擴建可能導致製造效率低下、額外費用，包括較高的工資或遣散費用，以及成本低效率，這可能會對財務結果造成負面影響。
